description: Retrieves a list of promotion codes from a Stripe account with optional filters for active status, code value, coupon association, and customer restrictions. Supports cursor-based pagination.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for listing promotion codes, with filtering and pagination options.

active.description: Filter promotion codes by active status. If true, returns only active codes; if false, returns only inactive codes.
active.title: Active

code.description: Only return promotion codes that have this case-insensitive code.
code.title: Code

coupon.description: Only return promotion codes for this coupon ID.
coupon.title: Coupon

created.description: Filter based on creation timestamp. Supports sub-parameters: 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal) with Unix timestamp values.
created.title: Created

customer.description: Only return promotion codes that are restricted to this customer ID.
customer.title: Customer

customer_account.description: Only return promotion codes that are restricted to this account representing the customer.
customer_account.title: Customer Account

ending_before.description: Cursor for pagination - returns objects before this object ID.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Maximum number of promotion code objects to return (1-100). Default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

starting_after.description: Cursor for pagination - returns objects after this object ID.
starting_after.title: Starting After

inputSchema.title: GetPromotionCodesRequest

name: get_promotion_codes

CouponData.description: Details of a Stripe coupon associated with a promotion code.

amount_off.description: Amount (in cents) to be deducted from the subtotal of any invoices for this customer.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

created.description: Creation timestamp in Unix epoch seconds.
created.title: Created

duration.description: How long the discount will be in effect (once, repeating, or forever).
duration.title: Duration

duration_in_months.description: Number of months the coupon applies (only if duration is 'repeating').
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Indicates if this is in production (true) or test mode (false).
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers.
name.title: Name

percent_off.description: Percent that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Date after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Taking account of the above properties, whether this coupon can still be applied to a customer.
valid.title: Valid

CouponData.title: CouponData

minimum_amount.description: Minimum amount required to redeem this promotion code for this currency (in smallest currency unit).
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

GetPromotionCodesResponse.description: Response containing a list of promotion codes and pagination details.

data.description: Array of promotion code objects. Empty if no promotion codes match or exist.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: True if more promotion code objects are available via pagination.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: Object type; always 'list' for a list of promotion codes.
object.title: Object

url.description: API URL of the retrieved list, typically '/v1/promotion_codes'.
url.title: Url

GetPromotionCodesResponse.title: GetPromotionCodesResponse

PromotionCodeData.description: Details of a Stripe promotion code.

active.description: Whether the promotion code is currently active (depends on coupon validity).
active.title: Active

coupon.description: The associated coupon object with full details.
coupon.title: Coupon

created.description: Creation timestamp in Unix epoch seconds.
created.title: Created

customer.description: ID of customer eligible for redemption, or null if available to all.
customer.title: Customer

customer_account.description: ID of associated customer account, or null.
customer_account.title: Customer Account

expires_at.description: Final redemption date as Unix timestamp, or null if no expiration.
expires_at.title: Expires At

id.description: Unique identifier for the promotion code.
id.title: Id

livemode.description: Indicates if this is in production (true) or test mode (false).
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this code can be redeemed, or null for unlimited.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: Object type; always 'promotion_code' for promotion codes.
object.title: Object

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this code has been redeemed.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

PromotionCodeData.title: PromotionCodeData

Restrictions.description: Redemption restrictions for a promotion code.

currency_options.description: Per-currency restrictions. Keys are three-letter ISO currency codes.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

first_time_transaction.description: Whether this code can only be used for first-time transactions.
first_time_transaction.title: First Time Transaction

Restrictions.title: Restrictions
